decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-008068 posted on 2026-10-06 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 24 days later, inside the 120-day limit. The card has two postings of 95.87 EUR at SALTMARSH ENERGY (MER-000075), both posted on 2026-10-06. TXN-008067 was made at 11:49:58Z on 2026-10-05 under AUTH-008260. TXN-008068, the disputed one, was made at 13:49:58Z that day under AUTH-008261. The two postings do not share an authorisation. Each has its own approved contactless authorisation, two hours apart, and neither carries a fraud flag. No refund is on record for either posting. Under the policy, two postings with their own authorisations made some time apart are two purchases, even at the same merchant for the same amount, so this is not a duplicate charge and the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Our records show two separate card payments of 95.87 EUR at SALTMARSH ENERGY on 2026-10-05, about two hours apart, and each was approved on its own. That makes them two purchases rather than one purchase charged twice, so we can't treat this as a duplicate charge. If you didn't make one of these payments, please contact us so we can look into it as a separate matter.
